$comment: Fake deployment scenario for the refused-write acceptance of Task 10.
The torque write is accepted at first, refused for 1.2 s, and accepted
again afterwards. The refusal window is entered while the runtime is
tracking, so the state machine has to latch the refusal as a fault, write
zero torque instead in the same tick, and release the fault only through a
matching Reset after the recovery window saw accepted writes again.
The measured velocity steps once inside the window so the refused write
carries a non-zero attempted torque, which is what tells the refused record
apart from the zero-torque fallback that follows it.
elapsed_us is monotonic from process start; an entry applies from its time
onwards and holds until the next one.
